rasterize_meshes: rasterize a batch of 3D meshes into pixel-to-face indices, z-buffer, barycentric coords, and pixel distances
rasterize_meshes_python: run the naive Python reference implementation of mesh rasterization for comparison against the CUDA version
edge_function: compute the signed area of the parallelogram formed by a point and a 2D line segment
barycentric_coordinates: compute the barycentric coordinates of a point relative to a triangle given its three vertices
point_triangle_distance: calculate the shortest distance from a point to the edges of a triangle
